title: Padded parity input
statement: For a natural number $n$, a sign vector $x\in\{−1,1\}^n$, and an index $i\in\mathbb{N}$, define the padded input to equal the $i$th coordinate of $x$ when $i<n$, and to equal $1$ when $i\ge n$.
